description.value: A small, intimate campground tucked along Wilson Creek just off Highway 6, 5 km north of New Denver, with Valhalla Park rising across Slocan Lake to the west; well-positioned as a base for backcountry exploration of Valhalla, Kokanee Glacier, Goat Range, nearby ghost-mining towns, and natural hot springs.

address.value: 650 Rosebery Pk Rd, New Denver, BC V0G 1S1, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active 33-site frontcountry campground along Wilson Creek on Highway 6, 5 km north of New Denver. The park page prominently features a 'Book camping' button and the frontcountry camping policy page confirms reservations are available at provincial campgrounds, making Reservations accepted=true. No specific amenity details (showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, etc.) appear in the fetched content, so those remain null; the website does explicitly state e-bikes are restricted to park roads and not allowed on trails.
concerns: OSM name contains a spelling error: 'Provicial' should be 'Provincial'. The BC Parks website refers to this place as 'Rosebery Park', not 'Rosebery Provincial Campground'.

OSM phone (+1-866-937-5734) appears to be the operator (West Kootenay Park Management Inc.) line and could not be confirmed from the fetched website content; the BC Parks contact page lists different general numbers (1-800-689-9025).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks provincial campground on a key Kootenay touring corridor (Highway 6); confirmed bookable with 33 sites in a forested creek setting — a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website explicitly states e-bikes are not allowed on trails within Rosebery Park and are restricted to park roads — relevant for cyclists planning to use this as a base for trail riding.
